name: Prosegur Compañía de Seguridad, S.A.
summary: Prosegur Compañía de Seguridad, S.A. operates in the private security sector. It operates through Security, Cash, Alarms, Cybersecurity, and AVOS (added-value outsourcing services) segments. The Security segment engages in guarding and protection of premises, goods and individuals, and activities related to technological security solutions.
